statements.formal_part: only the last step of case (iii), over the reals: X ↦ (tr(X)I + Xᵀ)/2 is injective on real matrices (polar_trace_injective); the paper needs complex matrices, which follows by applying it to the real and imaginary parts — that step is not formalized

statements.formal_part: pieces: the closing count (support_triples); the case s = a = r (case_s_eq_a), the case s < a with two hypotheses (the inclusion in im T_b of (3) and a one-dimensional radical; case_s_lt_a) and the Observation (observation), each concluding a nonzero FACTORISATION of the functional — in all three, the passage to a nonzero simple tensor α ⊗ β in im H uses the bilinearity of the paper and is not formalized. The Segre bound r ≤ (a−1)(b₀−1), the generic b and the assembly are not formalized

fidelity.note: The caveat about \(\operatorname{im}H\) must also cover the case \(s<a\) and the Observation, since `case_s_lt_a` and `observation` conclude a nonzero factorisation, whereas the Observation of the paper concludes \(0\ne\alpha\otimes\beta\in\operatorname{im}H\).
